calls.title: Teresa / Kari
calls.summary: The team focused on creating reusable components and migrating legacy code to enhance consistency and maintainability. Teresa is developing an agent to enforce design rules, initially targeting simpler components like buttons and containers due to their easier migration. The migration approach is incremental, prioritizing high-traffic pages for optimal user experience. Additionally, visual inconsistencies in table designs were addressed to improve color contrast across themes. QA processes for newly developed components include early reviews and focused migrations on critical areas. Challenges in theming, particularly with tooltips and popovers, were also discussed, alongside a two-step workflow for better efficiency and communication.
calls.keywords: Radix migration, Component automation, Design system, Table styling, AI agent workflows, Dark/light theming

calls.title: Teresa / Kari
calls.summary: The team discussed advancements in the modular design system to create reusable skills that maintain design clarity and consistency. Teresa Yung emphasized structuring design rules hierarchically, while Kari Kay expressed concerns about the system's handling of up to 1,000 lines of design rules. Challenges with AI-generated code and Figma integration were also highlighted, with calls for improved collaboration and more structured design reviews before the mid-July beta release. The ongoing pressure to deliver features and the need for iterative human oversight in AI applications were evident throughout the discussions, underscoring the dynamic nature of design development within the team.
calls.keywords: design system, Claude code, Figma integration, AI skill mapping, UI consistency, iterative feedback loops
